items.name: uv (Python runner)
items.why: runs every xp command and installs Python packages on demand

items.name: NVIDIA GPU / driver
items.why: VoiceStudio runs much faster on an NVIDIA GPU

items.name: VoiceStudio (narration API :3900)
items.why: generates narration and word timestamps (local voice cloning)
items.action: xp setup --install voicestudio   (official release from github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio for this OS/CPU, SHA-256 verified, per-user install without admin; on macOS it also runs xattr -cr /Applications/VoiceStudio.app because the app is not notarized; then opens it and waits for the API)

items.name: Voice samples
items.why: cloned narration voice (≤ 10 s ref.wav + exact ref.txt)
items.action: Quick start: xp voice add --archetype documentarian (built-in English narrator). Own voice: ask the user for an audio OR video file of the voice (≥ 15 s of one person speaking; music is removed automatically) and confirm they own it or have permission → xp voice add <file> --name <name> --consent

items.name: Pixabay API key
items.action: Add PIXABAY_API_KEY=<key> to .env (copy .env.example; free key: https://pixabay.com/api/docs/)

items.name: Pexels API key
items.action: Add PEXELS_API_KEY=<key> to .env (copy .env.example; free key: https://www.pexels.com/api/)

items.name: YouTube API key
items.why: optional viral research (xp viral): metadata of top videos on a topic
items.action: Optional: Google Cloud Console → enable "YouTube Data API v3" → Credentials → API key → add YOUTUBE_API_KEY=<key> to .env

items.name: Auto-download policy
items.why: allows xp assets to download licensed assets automatically (sources, licence, MB limit per video)
items.action: Ask the user to approve auto-downloads from Pixabay/Pexels/NASA/Poly Haven/ambientCG (≤ 1 GB per video), then: xp setup --policy

items.name: BiRefNet model
items.action: xp setup --install birefnet   (~973 MB; otherwise downloaded on first use)

items.name: Blender
items.action: Optional: unzip portable Blender into .mega-shot/tools/ (https://www.blender.org/download/) or set MS_BLENDER

items.name: huashu-art-motion skill
items.why: drawn styles: sketch/whiteboard, flat 2D, kinetic type, 3b1b, 35 painterly styles (xp art)

items.name: Music composer + samples
items.why: original per-video music from an ABC score (xp compose)

items.name: Free disk space
items.why: a long series needs ~10–20 GB (assets, frames, masters)
